sub_sector.value: OTC securities trading marketplaces; market data and corporate services

financial_business_type.detail: Operates regulated electronic markets for US over-the-counter securities, plus data licensing and issuer services.

revenue_driver.detail: Fees from issuer subscription services, market data licensing and trading platform (broker-dealer) services.

customer_type.detail: Listed issuers, broker-dealers and market data subscribers; investors access via brokers.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Fee-based marketplace operator; no lending or underwriting risk.

notes: Website evidence was unavailable; description relies on prior knowledge of the company.
